DEPOSIT_PENDING.title: Confirm the order?
DEPOSIT_PENDING.body: Your purchase order is issued and the deposit becomes due.

IN_PRODUCTION.title: Start production?
IN_PRODUCTION.body: Confirm the deposit has arrived (or resume production).

QC.title: Ready for inspection?
QC.body: All stages are complete and the goods are ready to inspect.

READY_TO_SHIP.title: Inspection passed?
READY_TO_SHIP.body: The goods passed inspection and can ship.

SHIPPED.title: Ship
SHIPPED.body: Orders ship when their GarmentGate shipment leaves the hub.

COMPLETED.title: Complete the order?
COMPLETED.body: Everything arrived as agreed. The balance is released to the factory.

DISPUTED.title: Report a problem
DISPUTED.body: GarmentGate reviews the order with both sides. Tell us what went wrong.

REWORK.title: Send the order back for rework?
REWORK.body: The factory fixes the defects the inspector found, then the goods are inspected again.

CHOOSE_SAMPLING.title: Sample first, or go straight to production?
CHOOSE_SAMPLING.body: A sample lets you check fit, fabric and finish before bulk. Reorders of an approved style can skip it.

FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.title: Your sample is being made
FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.body: The factory ships it soon; you’ll get the tracking number here.

REVIEW_SAMPLE.title: Your sample has shipped: review it
REVIEW_SAMPLE.body: Approve it, or tell the factory what to change (photos help).

CONFIRM_ORDER.title: Sample approved: confirm the order
CONFIRM_ORDER.body: Confirming issues your purchase order; production starts once the deposit arrives.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Pay the {deposit} deposit
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Payment details are on your purchase order. Production starts as soon as it arrives.

PRODUCTION.title: In production: {stage}
PRODUCTION.body: Photos from the factory appear on each stage as it progresses.

INSPECTION.title: Final inspection
INSPECTION.body: GarmentGate’s inspector checks a random sample against AQL. Pick a date below if you want a say.

SHIP.title: Balance received: getting ready to ship
SHIP.body: The factory delivers to GarmentGate’s hub; tracking and your documents appear here once it leaves.

IN_TRANSIT.title: On its way with GarmentGate
IN_TRANSIT.body: Follow it under GarmentGate tracking. Confirm delivery when the goods arrive: that releases the final payment to the factory.

CONFIRM_COMPLETION.title: Delivered: is everything right?
CONFIRM_COMPLETION.body: Complete the order, or report a problem within 14 days.

RESOLVE_DISPUTE.title: We’re resolving your dispute
RESOLVE_DISPUTE.body: GarmentGate is working with the factory and will update you.

DONE.title: Order completed
DONE.body: Need more? Reorder the same style in a click.

CANCELLED.title: Order cancelled
CANCELLED.body: Message GarmentGate if you have questions.

QC_FAILED.title: The final inspection failed
QC_FAILED.body: See the defects below. Send the order back for rework (it’s inspected again), or report a problem.

PAY_BALANCE.title: Inspection passed: pay the {balance} balance
PAY_BALANCE.body: The factory ships as soon as it arrives. Funds stay in escrow until each milestone.

CHOOSE_SHIPPING.title: Choose how this order ships
CHOOSE_SHIPPING.body: GarmentGate’s freight or your own forwarder collecting at our hub. The factory books its pickup once you’ve chosen.

CHOOSE_SAMPLING.title: Nothing to do right now
CHOOSE_SAMPLING.body: We’ll let you know when it’s your turn.

FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.title: Make and ship the sample
FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.body: Follow the brief, then add the courier and tracking number.

REVIEW_SAMPLE.title: The buyer is reviewing your sample
REVIEW_SAMPLE.body: You’ll hear as soon as they decide.

CONFIRM_ORDER.title: Sample approved
CONFIRM_ORDER.body: Waiting for the buyer to confirm the order.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Order confirmed
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Your purchase order is ready. Production starts when the deposit arrives.

PRODUCTION.title: Production: {stage}
PRODUCTION.body: Update each stage and add photos or videos: buyers love seeing progress.

INSPECTION.title: Final inspection
INSPECTION.body: GarmentGate’s inspector visits to check a random AQL sample. Have the packed goods ready.

SHIP.title: Balance received: send it to the hub
SHIP.body: Add packing details, book the pickup to GarmentGate’s hub and print the carton markings. The order ships when it leaves the hub.

CONFIRM_COMPLETION.title: Delivered
CONFIRM_COMPLETION.body: Waiting for the buyer to confirm.

CANCELLED.title: Order cancelled
CANCELLED.body: Message GarmentGate if you have questions.

QC_FAILED.title: The final inspection failed
QC_FAILED.body: See the defects below. The buyer decides on rework; GarmentGate will be in touch.

PAY_BALANCE.title: Inspection passed: get it to the hub
PAY_BALANCE.body: Add packing details and book the pickup. It leaves the hub once the buyer’s balance is in.

CHOOSE_SHIPPING.title: Waiting for the buyer’s shipping choice
CHOOSE_SHIPPING.body: Add your packing details meanwhile. You’ll book the pickup to GarmentGate’s hub once the buyer has chosen.

CHOOSE_SAMPLING.title: Buyer to choose sampling
CHOOSE_SAMPLING.body: Draft order: the buyer requests a sample or confirms.

FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.title: Factory to ship the sample
FACTORY_SHIPS_SAMPLE.body: Chase the factory if it’s late.

REVIEW_SAMPLE.title: Buyer reviewing the sample
REVIEW_SAMPLE.body: Follow up if the buyer goes quiet.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Deposit pending
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Start production when the deposit is in.

PRODUCTION.title: In production
PRODUCTION.body: Review the factory’s photos in Moderation.

INSPECTION.title: Final inspection
INSPECTION.body: Assign an inspector below; their report moves the order on.

SHIP.title: Factory to deliver to the hub
SHIP.body: Receive it at the hub, then build and send the shipment in Logistics.

IN_TRANSIT.title: In transit
IN_TRANSIT.body: Confirm delivery if the buyer doesn’t.

CONFIRM_COMPLETION.title: Delivered
CONFIRM_COMPLETION.body: Waiting for the buyer to complete.

RESOLVE_DISPUTE.title: Resolve the dispute
RESOLVE_DISPUTE.body: Resume where it was, complete, or cancel.

QC_FAILED.title: Final inspection failed
QC_FAILED.body: Waiting for the buyer to choose rework or a dispute.

PAY_BALANCE.title: Balance due
PAY_BALANCE.body: Confirm the buyer’s transfer in Finance when it arrives.

CHOOSE_SHIPPING.title: Buyer to choose shipping
CHOOSE_SHIPPING.body: The factory can’t book its pickup until the buyer picks GarmentGate freight or its own forwarder.

preferences.currencyHint: Prices and invoices stay in the order’s currency; this adds an approximate conversion at GarmentGate’s reference rate.

disputes.title: Dispute
disputes.mediating: GarmentGate is reviewing this with both sides. Reply in the order thread if we ask for anything.
disputes.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: 120 of 2,000 pieces have uneven stitching on the side seam (photos attached).
disputes.evidenceHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 15 MB each
disputes.evidenceReview: GarmentGate checks every file before the other side sees it.

open.title: Report a problem
open.body: GarmentGate reviews the order with both sides and decides, including any refund from escrow. Production pauses while the dispute is open.
open.done: Dispute opened. GarmentGate will be in touch.

resolve.title: Resolve the dispute
resolve.body: Both sides are notified. The factory never sees refund amounts.
resolve.resolutionHint: Shown to both sides (the factory’s copy is scrubbed of the buyer’s names).
resolve.refundHint: Optional. Up to {max} is still in escrow.

admin.title: Disputes
admin.description: Take a dispute on, check the evidence and resolve it from the order.
admin.emptyBody: When a buyer reports a problem on an order, it shows up here.
admin.toReview: {count, plural, one {# file to review} other {# files to review}}
admin.claimHint: This order left with GarmentGate ({shipment}). If the goods were lost or damaged in transit, settle it through a logistics claim.

reviews.title: Reviews

intro.BUYER: Rate the factory. Your review is shown on its profile with your country only.
intro.MANUFACTURER: Rate the buyer. Only GarmentGate and the buyer see it.

reviews.theirsPending: The other side has left a review. You’ll see it once you leave yours, or after the review period.
reviews.closed: The review period for this order has ended.

commentPlaceholder.BUYER: How was the quality, fit and finish? Would you order again?
commentPlaceholder.MANUFACTURER: Were the specs clear? Was the buyer responsive?

reviews.publicEmptyBody: Reviews appear here after buyers complete orders with this factory.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: How the marketplace is doing, and what’s waiting for the team.

kpis.gmvHint: {count, plural, one {# confirmed order} other {# confirmed orders}}, at buyer prices
kpis.activeHint: From sampling to delivery, incl. disputes
kpis.conversionHint: {converted, number} of {rfqs, number} RFQs became an order

overview.skipped: Orders in {currencies} are left out of the USD totals: they have no exchange rate yet.

charts.gmvBody: Confirmed orders at the buyer price, in USD, by month of confirmation.
charts.revenueBody: Markup paid by buyers plus commission withheld from factories, in USD.
charts.conversionBody: Share of RFQs published each month that became an order.

table.show: Show the monthly figures as a table

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Every order with both sides’ prices and the platform’s revenue.
orders.emptyBody: Orders appear here when a buyer accepts a quote.

override.title: Override the status of {code}
override.body: It’s {status} now. This skips the normal checks, so only use it to fix a mistake or record something agreed outside the platform. Both sides are notified.
override.reasonHint: Saved in the order history and the audit log.

refund.title: Refund on {code}
refund.body: Refunds come out of escrow that hasn’t been released yet: up to {max}.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Confirm buyer transfers, release escrow to factories and record payouts.
payments.released: Tranche released to the factory’s payable

empty.confirmBody: Bank transfers and LCs appear here once a buyer marks them as sent.
empty.releaseBody: Tranches become due as orders reach their milestones.
empty.payBody: Released tranches wait here until the bank transfer to the factory is recorded.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm {reference}
confirmDialog.body: {amount} from {buyer}. Check it against the bank statement before confirming.
confirmDialog.upload: Upload the statement, SWIFT copy or LC
confirmDialog.bankReferenceHint: As it appears on the statement.

rejectDialog.title: Reject {reference}
rejectDialog.body: The buyer is told the payment couldn’t be matched and can try again.

payoutDialog.title: Payout for {order}
payoutDialog.body: {amount} to {factory}. Record it once the bank transfer has gone out.
payoutDialog.settlementHint: Pick another currency if the factory was paid in it; today’s stored rate converts it.

ledger.title: Ledger by currency
ledger.explain: Reconciled means debits equal credits, cash equals escrow + payables + revenue, and cash matches the payments recorded in and out. Totals above are in USD at the stored rates.

users.title: Users
users.description: Every account, with its company and moderation record.
users.emptyBody: People appear here when they sign up.
users.violations: {count, plural, one {# hit} other {# hits}} (30 days)

warn.title: Warn {name}
warn.body: They see the warning in the app with your note.
warn.placeholder: e.g. Please keep phone numbers and emails out of messages: GarmentGate relays everything.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}
suspend.body: They are signed out everywhere within minutes and can’t sign in until reactivated. Their company and orders are unaffected.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Everything staff and the platform did: who, what and on which record.
audit.emptyBody: Pick a longer period to see older entries.
audit.capped: Showing the latest 2,000 entries. Pick a shorter period to see everything in it.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Certificates factories added after verification. Buyers only see verified ones.
certifications.verified: Certificate verified: buyers can see it now
certifications.rejected: Certificate rejected: the factory has been told why
certifications.rejectBody: The factory sees your reason and can upload a new copy.
certifications.emptyBody: Certificates appear here when factories add them from their profile.

claims.title: Supplier claims
claims.description: Brands factories say they supply. Check the evidence; buyers only see a badge with the count, never the names.
claims.rejectBody: The factory sees your reason and can submit again with other evidence.
claims.emptyBody: Claims appear here when factories add brands from their profile.

supplierClaims.description: Tell us which brands you supply and upload proof. Once verified, buyers see a badge such as “Supplies 3 major brands in the EU”. Brand names are never shown to buyers.
supplierClaims.emptyBody: Verified brand experience is one of the strongest signals buyers look for.
supplierClaims.privacy: Brand names and evidence are seen only by GarmentGate staff.
supplierClaims.dialogDescription: Name the brands you supply in one region, then upload a purchase order, invoice or supplier certificate as evidence.
supplierClaims.brandsHint: Press Enter after each brand. Up to 20.
supplierClaims.evidenceHint: Prices and quantities may be blacked out. Up to 10 MB.
supplierClaims.badge: {tier, select, MAJOR {{count, plural, one {Supplies a major brand in {region}} other {Supplies # major brands in {region}}}} other {{count, plural, one {Supplies an established brand in {region}} other {Supplies # established brands in {region}}}}}

page.title: Capacity
page.description: Open line time for buyers to book, and keep your monthly pieces up to date for quote requests.

calendar.emptyBody: Describe each line’s daily output in SAM minutes and your CM rate, then open windows buyers can book.
calendar.dragHint: Drag across days to open a window

lineDialog.description: Buyers book line time in SAM minutes. They never see your line codes or exact headcount.
lineDialog.name: Name
lineDialog.dailySamHint: Operators × minutes per shift × efficiency, e.g. 30 × 480 × 75% = 10,800.
lineDialog.rateHint: What you charge to cut, make and trim.
lineDialog.statusHint: Paused lines can’t open new windows; retired lines leave the calendar.
lineDialog.cantDelete: This line has bookings: retire it instead

slotDialog.newDescription: Buyers can book minutes in this window. You can shrink it later, but never below what’s booked.
slotDialog.offerHint: Leave empty to offer the line’s full capacity.
slotDialog.capacity: {days, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}, up to {minutes, number} minutes
slotDialog.rate: Booked at your CM rate of {rate} per 100 minutes.

deposit.body: Pay the deposit to GarmentGate by bank transfer, quoting the reference. It stays in escrow; the booking is confirmed once it arrives and the factory has accepted.

buyerPage.title: Book capacity
buyerPage.description: Reserve line time at verified factories: you pay for SAM minutes, then turn them into an order.

search.samHint: SAM = standard minutes to sew one piece (a basic tee is about 8–12).
search.introBody: Choose a product, how much you need and when. We show factories with open lines, by code only.
search.emptyBody: Try a wider date range, a parent category, or fewer minutes.
search.partnershipHint: Ask for the same minutes on this line every month

partnership.title: Ask for a partnership
partnership.description: The same minutes on this line every month, for 6 to 12 months, at today’s rate. Each month’s deposit is due two weeks before it starts.
partnership.terms: I agree to the partnership and cancellation terms.

flow.title: Book line time
flow.description: Three steps: how much of the window, the terms, then the deposit.
flow.failed: We couldn’t place the hold. Please try again.
flow.availability: Booked, your request and free minutes in this window
flow.samHint: Optional: we’ll show how many pieces fit.
flow.noteHint: Product details only: contact details are removed.
flow.payLater: Pay later from the booking page

SLOT.title: Some minutes
SLOT.body: Book the minutes you need; the rest stays open to others.

LINE.title: The whole window
LINE.body: Every free minute of the line for these dates.

flow.holdRule: We hold these minutes for {hours} hours. The booking is confirmed when the factory accepts and your deposit arrives.
flow.cancellation: If you cancel a confirmed booking:
flow.tier: {days, plural, =0 {Later than that: {percent} back} other {# days or more before the start: {percent} back}}
flow.expiryRule: If the hold runs out or the factory declines, you get the whole deposit back.
flow.accept: I agree to the booking and cancellation terms.

convert.title: Convert {code} to an order
convert.description: Your deposit counts toward the order and unused minutes go back to the factory.

CMT.title: CMT
CMT.body: You supply fabric and trims; the order is priced at your booked rate × SAM per piece.

FULL_PACKAGE.title: Full package
FULL_PACKAGE.body: The factory sources everything: we ask it for a quote first.

convert.returned: Uses {needed} minutes; {returned} go back to the factory.
convert.packageHint: Fabric, trims, labels, packing. Contact details are removed.

dashboard.emptyBody: Reserve line time ahead of the season, then turn it into an order.
dashboard.partnershipTerms: {minutes} min a month for {months} months from {start}
dashboard.cancelPartnershipBody: Months that haven’t started are cancelled: held months free, confirmed ones under the cancellation terms.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Pay the deposit
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Your minutes are held. Pay the deposit before the hold runs out to keep them.

AWAIT_PAYMENT_CHECK.title: Checking your transfer
AWAIT_PAYMENT_CHECK.body: We’ll confirm your deposit as soon as it reaches our account.

AWAIT_FACTORY.title: Waiting for the factory
AWAIT_FACTORY.body: Your deposit is in escrow. The factory has until the hold ends to accept; if it doesn’t, you get it all back.

CONVERT.title: Convert to an order
CONVERT.body: Your line time is confirmed. Turn it into an order before production starts.

AWAIT_QUOTE.title: Waiting for the quote
AWAIT_QUOTE.body: The factory is preparing a full-package quote. Accept it to create the order.

TRACK_ORDER.title: Order in progress
TRACK_ORDER.body: This booking is now an order. Follow production there.

detail.checking: We’re checking a transfer you marked as sent.
detail.tier: {days, plural, =0 {Later than that: {percent} back} other {# days or more before the start: {percent} back}}
detail.cancelBody: The minutes go back to the factory. Your refund follows the cancellation terms.

inbox.emptyBody: Open windows on your lines and buyers can book them here.
inbox.toAnswer: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to answer} one {# request to answer} other {# requests to answer}}
inbox.compensation: You receive {amount} from the cancelled booking
inbox.partnershipTerms: {minutes} min a month for {months} months from {start}
inbox.partnershipHint: Accepting reserves every month at once from your open windows on this line.
inbox.declineBody: The buyer sees your reason, and any deposit goes back to them.

admin.title: Capacity booking
admin.description: Booking fee, deposits and cancellation policy, and every booking with both sides’ real identities.
admin.settingsHint: New bookings use these; existing ones keep the terms they were booked with.

fields.factoryShare: Factory share of a kept deposit (%)

hints.bookingFee: Added to the factory’s CM rate for buyers.
hints.deposit: Of the buyer amount, paid into escrow.

admin.tiersHint: From the most days ahead to the fewest; the last starts at 0 days.
admin.cancelBody: Staff cancellations refund the buyer in full and free the minutes.
admin.emptyBody: Bookings appear here when buyers hold line time.

admin.title: Logistics
admin.description: GarmentGate ships every order: partners only ever deal with GarmentGate, and neither side sees the other’s name or address.

rates.description: What partners charge GarmentGate per kg, CBM, container or shipment. Staff only: buyers see GarmentGate’s price, never these costs.
rates.emptyBody: Add a partner first, then the routes they quote.
rates.dialogDescription: Leave a port empty to cover every port in that country.

preview.title: Price a route
preview.description: What GarmentGate would pay and charge, from today’s rate cards and margins.
preview.none: No valid rate card covers that route and date.

partners.description: Forwarders, couriers, truckers and customs brokers. They only ever see GarmentGate as their customer.
partners.emptyBody: Add the companies that move goods for GarmentGate.
partners.dialogDescription: Contacts are for GarmentGate staff only.

fields.name: Company name
fields.active: Active: their rate cards can be used

partners.usersBody: They sign in to the partner portal and only see GarmentGate’s bookings with this partner. Inviting emails them a link to set a password.

hubs.description: Warehouses where factories deliver. Factories see the hub’s address; buyers never do.
hubs.emptyBody: Add the warehouses where goods are received, checked and consolidated.
hubs.dialogDescription: The code includes the country, like HUB-BD-01.

margins.description: GarmentGate’s markup on freight. The most specific active rule wins: mode, then destination, then origin.
margins.emptyBody: Without a rule, freight is passed on at cost.
margins.dialogDescription: Leave mode or countries empty to cover them all.

duties.description: Import duty by HS code and destination, used for landed-cost estimates only. The longest matching HS prefix wins.
duties.emptyBody: Buyers see landed costs without duty until you add rates.
duties.dialogDescription: Use as many HS digits as the rate applies to (6109 covers all T-shirts).
duties.noteHint: e.g. the tariff source or a trade agreement.

GARMENT_GATE_EXPORTER.title: GarmentGate exports
GARMENT_GATE_EXPORTER.body: GarmentGate is shipper on every document, straight from the factory or a hub.

SWITCH_BL.title: Switch B/L
SWITCH_BL.body: The first bill of lading names the factory (staff only); the switched one names GarmentGate.

HUB_CONSOLIDATION.title: Through a hub
HUB_CONSOLIDATION.body: Every order goes through a GarmentGate hub, where it is checked, relabelled and consolidated.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.description: GarmentGate ships your order and stays the shipper on every document. Choose how, see the landed cost, and pay into escrow.
shipping.cargoBasis: Priced on an estimate of {kg} kg and {cbm} CBM for your quantity; GarmentGate re-checks it when the factory packs.
shipping.none: No shipping prices for that destination yet. GarmentGate will contact you with a quote.
shipping.noDdp: Duties-paid delivery needs the product’s HS code, which GarmentGate adds when confirming your order.
shipping.estimateNote: Estimated for HS {hs}. Actual duty depends on the customs ruling, trade agreements and local taxes.
shipping.estimateNoHs: Duty isn’t included until GarmentGate confirms the HS code. Actual duty depends on customs.
shipping.paidNote: Paid: your shipping is booked with GarmentGate.

hsCode.title: HS code
hsCode.description: Used on shipping documents and for the buyer’s duty estimates.

factory.title: Shipping with GarmentGate
factory.description: GarmentGate ships this order. Tell us how it’s packed, book the pickup to our hub and put our carton markings on every carton.
factory.packLater: Packing details open once production starts.
factory.received: {cartons} cartons checked in at the hub on {date}.
factory.markingsHint: Print one per carton. They show GarmentGate, the hub and the carton number only.
factory.pickupLater: Book the pickup once the order is ready to ship and packing details are in.
factory.cartonSizeHint: Outer dimensions of one carton; all cartons the same.
factory.noHubs: GarmentGate has no hub in your country yet: we’ll contact you about collection.
factory.noteHint: Loading bay, opening hours. Contact details are removed.
factory.waitingForBuyer: Waiting for the buyer to choose how it ships. You can add packing details meanwhile.

together.title: Ship together with your other orders
together.description: Orders from the same country can share one shipment: one price for the combined cargo, shared by weight.
together.chosen: Shipping chosen for all the orders
together.none: No shared price for these orders: ship them separately.

board.description: Every order GarmentGate ships: pickups, hub receiving and shipments. Tick orders at a hub to put them on one shipment.
board.empty: No orders shipped by GarmentGate yet
board.emptyBody: Orders appear here once a buyer chooses a GarmentGate shipping option.
board.scheduleBody: The factory is told the date; the trucker stays with GarmentGate.
board.receiveBody: {cartons} cartons expected. Count, check and photograph them.

shipments.emptyBody: Create one from the Orders tab once goods are at a hub.

shipment.documentsHint: Each opens as a PDF and records its number. Partner papers consign to GarmentGate; only the buyer’s commercial papers name the buyer.
shipment.uploadsHint: Partners’ originals are staff only. Publish a cleaned copy (metadata removed, neutral name) once you’ve checked it names neither side.
shipment.departureHint: The first “In transit” is the departure: every order must be paid and every leg priced; the orders move to shipped and the shipping money leaves escrow.

partnerPortal.title: Bookings from GarmentGate
partnerPortal.description: Legs GarmentGate booked with you. GarmentGate is your customer for all of them.
partnerPortal.emptyBody: GarmentGate’s bookings with you appear here, with cargo, pickup and destination.
partnerPortal.acceptBody: Accept this booking to confirm you’ll carry it at the agreed rate.
partnerPortal.customer: Customer: GarmentGate. Invoice GarmentGate for this leg; questions go to GarmentGate operations.
partnerPortal.updateHint: GarmentGate passes updates on to its customer. Keep notes about the cargo and where it is.
partnerPortal.chargeback: Charged back {amount} (deducted from what GarmentGate pays you)
partnerPortal.claimOnLeg: GarmentGate opened a claim on this leg.

tracking.title: GarmentGate tracking
tracking.noUpdates: GarmentGate posts updates here as your goods move.
tracking.documentsLater: Shipping documents are issued once your goods leave the hub.
tracking.compensation: GarmentGate paid you {amount}; it appears under payments.
tracking.claimHandling: GarmentGate is handling this with its insurer and partners.

claims.description: Loss, damage, shortage or delay while goods were in GarmentGate’s care. Open a claim from the shipment (or the buyer’s dispute), submit it to the insurer, then settle: compensation to the buyer, recovery from the insurer, chargeback to the partner.
claims.emptyBody: Open one from a shipment that has left, or from a buyer’s dispute.
claims.submitBody: Record the insurer’s reference once you’ve filed the claim with them.
claims.settleBody: Everything here is recorded in the ledger at once: compensation is paid to the buyer by GarmentGate, the insurer’s payment comes in, and the chargeback reduces what we owe the partner.
claims.chargebackTo: From {partner}, up to the leg’s cost of {amount}
claims.noLeg: No leg was named when the claim was opened.
claims.openBody: Snapshots the insured value (110% of CIF) if the buyer took insurance.
claims.openFromDispute: Linked to the buyer’s dispute. Settle the claim here, then resolve the dispute without a refund.
claims.legHint: The leg where it happened; its partner can be charged back.
claims.publicNoteHint: Shown to the buyer, filtered and stripped of partner and factory names.

reports.description: Shipments that left in the period, with claims settled in it. Each currency is reported on its own.
reports.claimsCount: Claims: {open} open, {settled} settled and {rejected} rejected in this period.
reports.emptyPartners: No partner legs in this period

GARMENTGATE.title: GarmentGate ships it
GARMENTGATE.body: Sea, air or door to door, priced and insured by GarmentGate.

OWN.title: My own forwarder
OWN.body: Your forwarder collects from GarmentGate’s hub (FCA). No freight charge.

handover.explain: The factory delivers to a GarmentGate hub as usual. GarmentGate arranges the collection with your forwarder and hands the goods over there with GarmentGate’s papers. Your forwarder never deals with the factory.
handover.name: Forwarder
handover.contactHint: Email or phone GarmentGate uses to arrange the collection. Never shared with the factory.
handover.destinationHint: For the commercial invoice and certificate of origin.
handover.saved: Your forwarder will collect at GarmentGate’s hub
handover.how: GarmentGate tells your forwarder when the goods are ready at the hub. Your order ships when they collect.
